notes.title: New update: Helper hamster!
notes.content:
A helper hamster has been added, which has a map of the city, and sometimes he will be able to suggest the approximate location of objects!)

[b]Added:[/b]
- Help in the game every 3 minutes.
[b]Changed:[/b]
- Now you can choose any difficulty level right from the start of the game.
- In the description of the achievements, it is precisely indicated on which difficulty levels you can get the achievement.
[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Minor fixes with the location of objects.

notes.title: Added 6 languages!
notes.content:
Added 6 languages!

Thanks to those who helped with the translations:
Czech translated by siSINka_CZ.
Norwegian translated by Guyra.
Dutch translated by Charlotte.
Polish translated by zell.san.
Irish and French translated by default.

Minor bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: Now available on macOS and Linux! As well as control with a gamepad!
notes.content:
Added:
- Now available on macOS and Linux!
- Play with a gamepad!

[u]Update the game for the updates to take effect.[/u]

tags.feature: - Now available on macOS and Linux!

notes.title: Game optimization update! :)
notes.content:
Corrected:
- Now the game will not eat your computer's RAM.
- If you completed 7 levels before opening the last two, then when you enter the game you will receive achievements: Roses, Lizards, Cheese!)

I also want to say thanks to all the players who reported errors, thanks to you I was able to learn a lot of new things, and I can continue to please you with new games! )

notes.title: The last two levels are open again! Fixed minor bugs.
notes.content:
Fixed:
- Wrong word on the box in the train.
- Offset of numbers on some monitor resolutions.
- Corrected the position of objects.
- Getting three achievements.
- Adjusted the last two levels.

Work in progress:
- Increased performance on some devices.
- Errors when starting on weak PCs.
